name: Low-Gain Omni Antenna (S-Band)

name: Steerable High-Gain Dish (X-Band)

real.source_name: NASA Deep Space Network Technical Architecture

name: Ka-Band Phased Array Transceiver

name: Deep Space Optical Communications (DSOC)
